none: PAS DENO-F16131: Roman ring; finger ring inscribed 'TVT'; a variant of the Romano-Celtic TOT rings
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman finger ring; cast copper alloy finger ring of Henig type XI. The ring is of 2nd or 3rd century date. The ring has a narrow band of oval cross section which expands at the shoulders into a broad, flattened, roughly rectangular bezel. The bezel is decorated with incised lines running along either side, forming a border. These lines are crossed by further lines, giving a rough, hatched look.…
